seoTitle: Pasco County Schools Calendar 2026–27: Key Dates & PDF
seoDescription: Pasco County Schools starts Aug. 13, 2026, and ends May 28, 2027. See breaks, early-release days, make-up dates, return dates, and the official PCS PDF.
heroSummary: Pasco County Schools starts classes on Thursday, August 13, 2026. The last day for students is Friday, May 28, 2027. Thanksgiving Break is November 23–27, Winter Break is December 21–January 1, and Spring Break is March 22–26. February 12 and April 16 are scheduled school days but may become no-school days if PCS does not need them for make-up time. Students also have no school on January 4 and March 29 for teacher planning days.
calendarNotes: This page covers the districtwide Pasco County Schools 2026–27 Student/Teacher Calendar. Individual schools may publish separate dates for testing, athletics, open houses, graduation, bell schedules, and other campus events.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Pasco County Schools start in 2026?
When do students return after winter and spring breaks?
calendarFaqs.a: Students return Tuesday, January 5, after winter break and Tuesday, March 30, after spring break. January 4 and March 29 are teacher planning days with no school for students.

calendarFaqs.q: Which Pasco dates are conditional school days?
calendarFaqs.a: February 12 and April 16, 2027 are scheduled school days that may become no-school days if PCS does not need them for make-up time. Check PCS updates before making plans.

calendarFaqs.q: What is the June 1–4 make-up window?
calendarFaqs.a: PCS reserves June 1–4, 2027 to recover instructional time after an extended closure. This is a reserved make-up window, so families should confirm whether PCS plans to use those dates.

calendarFaqs.q: Can I subscribe to an auto-updating Pasco County Schools calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. PCS offers calendar subscriptions that update when the district changes its calendar. The official PDF and the MySchoolDates .ics download are static and do not update automatically.

calendarFaqs.q: Where should families check for calendar changes?
calendarFaqs.a: Check the official PCS calendar page and school announcements for revisions, emergency closures, bell schedules, and campus-specific events.

whatsNew.title: What Changed From 2025–26
content: The first student day is August 13, compared with August 11 in 2025–26.
Spring Break is March 22–26, compared with March 30–April 3 in 2025–26.
The 2026–27 calendar adds June 1–4 as a reserved extended-closure make-up window.
